Name: Monster House
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[quote][center][color=#ffff00][size=6]A Monster House !![/size][/color][/center]
[/quote][size=3]Add a building to the game that can warp to a floor with a large number of monsters.[/size]
[size=3]Construction will be done by Robin.[/size]

[size=4]This mod requires "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50043]T's Core[/url]" to function.[/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][/url]
Currently, English, Japanese and Chinese are supported.
The Chinese translation was provided by "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/181793031]lcy1998666[/url]".

Downloads.DisplayName: Option to increase the number of monsters
Downloads.Description:
The default number of monsters is min10max30, but this option can be overridden to min30max50.
If used, overwrite the main file.

[color=#ffff00][b]When updating from an older version, delete the old files before reinstalling.[/b][/color]
Solid Foundations is no longer required. Several additional options have also been added to GMCM.
